register_title: Material Unwanted Event register (FIXTURE, INVALID: one label names a thing)
provenance: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, DELIBERATELY INVALID. Identical to icmm_mue_l1.json except that MUE-08 carries the research note's own shorthand "tyre and rim" as its label. That shorthand is a pair of objects, not work performed, and installing it would put a thing at the root of the vector index where it is hardest to remove.
notes: Two fields per entry carry meaning. 'mue_title' is the register's own wording, kept verbatim so an auditor can match a row to the customer's document; MUE titles name EVENTS. 'label' is the functional rendering that becomes activity_node.label, and it names the WORK, because that is what survives asset re-tagging and org-chart churn. Both are kept so the second can be defended to the person who wrote the first.
